defect: The formal runner forwarded an arbitrary nonzero TLC exit without classifying semantic counterexamples separately from TLC/JVM/model infrastructure failures.

probe.setup: Build current TypeScript, then invoke scripts/formal.mjs with TLA2TOOLS_JAR pointing to a deliberately invalid local file.
probe.observedTail: Error: Could not find or load main class tlc2.TLC; Caused by: java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: tlc2.TLC

requiredFix: Unknown nonzero TLC exits must fail closed as infrastructure/tool failures. Only explicit TLC invariant/property/deadlock diagnostics may count as semantic counterexamples, and named mutation guards must require the intended invariant.
